passages.title: Notice on the door of Room 12
passages.text: Intermediate Group B: this week’s classes will be in Room 4 on the ground floor while new heating is put in here. Your teacher and lesson times stay the same.

passages.title: Email from the Student Office
passages.text: To all students: tickets for Friday’s trip to Bath are now on sale at reception. Payment is by card only. The coach leaves at 8.15 sharp and won’t wait for anyone who is late. Anna, Student Office

passages.title: Text message
passages.text: Marta – sorry, I can’t make our conversation exchange at 4 today! My dentist has moved my appointment. Could we do tomorrow at the same time instead? Same place, the library café. Let me know. Kenji

passages.title: Self-Study Centre
passages.text: Laptops can be borrowed for use in this room only. Show your student card at the desk. All laptops must be returned 15 minutes before the centre closes.

passages.title: Email from Ms Okafor
passages.text: Dear all, your writing test is next Wednesday. You will not be allowed to use dictionaries, but you can bring your own pens and a watch. Please check the noticeboard on Monday to find out which room you are in. Ms Okafor

questions.question: What does the notice say?
options: a) Group B’s lessons will start at a different time.
b) Group B will study in a different room this week.
c) Group B will have a new teacher for this week.
questions.explanation: The notice says "this week’s classes will be in Room 4" instead of Room 12. It also says "Your teacher and lesson times stay the same", so neither the teacher nor the time changes.

questions.question: What should students who want to go on the trip do?
options: a) Pay the coach driver on Friday morning.
b) Arrive at 8.15 to get their ticket.
c) Buy a ticket at reception using a card.
questions.explanation: Tickets are "on sale at reception" and "Payment is by card only". Nobody pays on the coach, and 8.15 is the time the coach "leaves", so it is too late to buy a ticket then.

questions.question: What does Kenji want to do?
options: a) Have the exchange on a different day
b) Stop doing the conversation exchange
c) Meet somewhere other than the library café
questions.explanation: Kenji asks "Could we do tomorrow at the same time instead?", so he wants to move the exchange to another day. He says "Same place, the library café", and he only cancels today’s meeting, not the whole exchange.

questions.question: What does the notice say about the laptops?
options: a) Students may only use them inside the centre.
b) Students can take them home if they show their card.
c) Students can keep them for 15 minutes at a time.
questions.explanation: Laptops are "for use in this room only", so they cannot leave the centre. The student card is shown "at the desk" to borrow one, not to take it home, and the 15 minutes refers to returning laptops "before the centre closes", not to how long you can use one.

questions.question: What does Ms Okafor tell the students?
options: a) The writing test will take place on Monday.
b) The test room will be announced on Monday.
c) They should bring a dictionary to the test.
questions.explanation: She asks students to "check the noticeboard on Monday to find out which room you are in". The test itself is "next Wednesday", and dictionaries are not allowed: "You will not be allowed to use dictionaries".
